points.body: Not a subcontractor from another district. The same team that surveys your roof installs on it.

points.title: The paperwork is ours
points.body: Portal application, net meter, MSEDCL approval. You do not visit a single office.

points.title: Waaree equipment throughout
points.body: Panels with a 25-year performance warranty, backed by the manufacturer, not by us alone.

points.title: We get you set up with Waaree
points.body: We register your system on the Waaree Support app at installation, so service and warranty requests go straight to the manufacturer — and our shop in Latur is here if you need a hand.

items.q: How much does a rooftop system cost?
items.a: It depends on your roof and how much electricity you use, so we do not put a price on this page that would be wrong for you. Send a photo of your bill on WhatsApp and we will give you a real figure for your roof, including the subsidy.

items.q: Do I have to apply for the subsidy myself?
items.a: No. We file the application on the PM Surya Ghar portal, arrange the net meter and take the MSEDCL approval through. The subsidy is paid directly into your bank account. You do not visit an office.
Usually seven days from the day material reaches your site. The survey happens before that, and the net meter and approval follow after.

items.q: What happens when it rains, or at night?
items.a: Your connection to the grid stays. At night and in heavy monsoon you draw from MSEDCL as usual; on sunny days your meter runs backwards. That is what the net meter is for.

items.q: What if a panel stops working?
items.a: Waaree panels carry a 25-year performance warranty and the inverter carries its own manufacturer warranty. Download and register on the Waaree Support app — the claim goes directly to Waaree, not through us. We register it for you at installation, and our shop is in Latur if you need a hand.

items.q: Can a shop or small business get this?
items.a: The PM Surya Ghar subsidy is for domestic connections. Commercial connections can still go solar and it usually pays back faster because your daytime usage is higher — we quote those separately.
